en: What does J’ai deux sœurs et un frère mean?
I have two sisters and a brother.
I have two brothers and a sister.
My two sisters have a brother.
J’ai means I have, sœurs are sisters and un frère is a brother.
What does Il fait chaud aujourd’hui mean?
It is hot today.
It is cold today.
It was hot yesterday.
Chaud means hot and aujourd’hui means today.
What does Mon chat dort sur le canapé mean?
My cat is sleeping on the sofa.
My cat is eating on the sofa.
My dog is sleeping under the sofa.
Dort comes from dormir (to sleep) and sur means on.
What does Nous allons à la piscine le mercredi mean?
We go to the swimming pool on Wednesdays.
We went to the beach on Wednesday.
We go to the swimming pool on Mondays.
La piscine is the swimming pool, and le mercredi means on Wednesdays.
What does Elle n’aime pas les carottes mean?
She doesn’t like carrots.
She loves carrots.
She doesn’t eat cakes.
N’aime pas means doesn’t like, and les carottes are carrots.
What does Il y a un arbre dans le jardin mean?
There is a tree in the garden.
There are trees in the park.
A tree is next to the house.
Il y a means there is, un arbre is a tree and le jardin is the garden.
What does Mes parents ont acheté une nouvelle voiture mean?
My parents bought a new car.
My parents are going to buy a new car.
My parents sold their old car.
Ont acheté is the past of acheter (to buy).
What does Je vais faire mes devoirs ce soir mean?
I am going to do my homework this evening.
I did my homework this morning.
I do my homework every evening.
Je vais faire is the near future, and ce soir means this evening.
What does Le train part à huit heures mean?
The train leaves at eight o’clock.
The train arrives at eight o’clock.
The train leaves at half past eight.
Part comes from partir (to leave), and huit heures is eight o’clock.
What does Ma grand-mère habite au bord de la mer mean?
My grandmother lives by the sea.
My grandmother lives in the mountains.
My grandmother swims in the sea.
Habite means lives, and au bord de la mer means by the sea.
What does Il pleut, alors je prends mon parapluie mean?
It is raining, so I take my umbrella.
It is sunny, so I take my hat.
It is raining, but I forget my umbrella.
Il pleut means it is raining, alors means so and le parapluie is the umbrella.
What does Tu as quel âge ? mean?
How old are you?
What is your name?
Where do you live?
In French you have an age, so tu as quel âge asks how old you are.
What does Je me couche à dix heures mean?
I go to bed at ten o’clock.
I get up at ten o’clock.
I go to bed at two o’clock.
Je me couche means I go to bed, and dix is ten.
What does Mon frère est plus grand que moi mean?
My brother is taller than me.
My brother is smaller than me.
My brother is as tall as me.
Plus grand que means taller than or bigger than.
What does Nous avons mangé une pizza hier soir mean?
We ate a pizza last night.
We are going to eat a pizza tonight.
We eat pizza every night.
Avons mangé is the past, and hier soir means yesterday evening.
What does Le magasin est fermé le dimanche mean?
The shop is closed on Sundays.
The shop is open on Sundays.
The shop is closed on Saturdays.
Fermé means closed and le dimanche means on Sundays.
What does J’ai mal à la tête mean?
I have a headache.
I have a sore foot.
I am happy.
Avoir mal à means to have a pain in, and la tête is the head.
What does Il est midi et demi mean?
It is half past twelve in the day.
It is midnight.
It is a quarter past twelve in the day.
Midi is twelve o’clock in the day, and et demi means half past.
What does Les élèves écoutent le professeur mean?
The pupils are listening to the teacher.
The teacher is listening to the pupils.
The pupils are looking at the teacher.
Les élèves are the pupils, and écoutent means are listening to.
What does Je ne mange jamais de viande mean?
I never eat meat.
I don’t eat meat any more.
I eat meat every day.
Ne … jamais means never, and la viande is meat.
What does Où est la boulangerie ? mean?
Where is the baker’s?
When does the baker’s open?
Is the baker’s open?
Où means where, and la boulangerie is the baker’s shop.
What does Mon anniversaire est le trois mai mean?
My birthday is on the third of May.
My birthday is on the third of March.
My birthday is in three months.
Trois is three and mai is May. March is mars.
What does Elle joue du piano depuis deux ans mean?
She has been playing the piano for two years.
She played the piano two years ago.
She plays the piano twice a year.
Depuis with the present means she started two years ago and still plays.
What does Il neige beaucoup en hiver mean?
It snows a lot in winter.
It rains a lot in winter.
It snowed a lot last winter.
Il neige means it snows, beaucoup means a lot and en hiver means in winter.
What does On se retrouve devant le cinéma mean?
Let’s meet in front of the cinema.
Let’s meet behind the cinema.
Let’s go inside the cinema.
Se retrouver means to meet up, and devant means in front of.
What does Mes amis sont allés au Canada mean?
My friends went to Canada.
My friends are going to go to Canada.
My friends live in Canada.
Sont allés is the past of aller, so they went.
What does Je voudrais un verre d’eau, s’il vous plaît mean?
I would like a glass of water, please.
I would like a bottle of milk, please.
I have drunk a glass of water, thank you.
Je voudrais means I would like, and un verre d’eau is a glass of water.
What does Le chien de mon voisin est très gentil mean?
My neighbour’s dog is very friendly.
My dog is very friendly to the neighbour.
My neighbour is very kind to dogs.
Le chien de mon voisin means the dog of my neighbour, so my neighbour’s dog.
What does Nous avons maths le lundi matin mean?
We have maths on Monday mornings.
We have maths on Monday afternoons.
We have maths every evening.
Le lundi matin means on Monday mornings.
What does Il faut tourner à gauche après le pont mean?
You have to turn left after the bridge.
You have to turn right after the bridge.
You have to turn left before the bridge.
À gauche means left and après means after.

example.q_en: What does J’ai deux sœurs et un frère mean?
example.answer_en: I have two sisters and a brother.
example.why_en: J’ai means I have, sœurs are sisters and un frère is a brother.

en.title: Reading French sentences
en.teach: To read a French sentence, find the person and the verb first, then look for words you know: J’ai deux sœurs means I have two sisters.
